We select the following widely utilized metrics to automatically evaluate LLM-generated explanations: BLEU, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, ROUGE-L, GPT3-Score (davinci-003), and BART-Score. We also use the BERT-score-based methods with different PLMs, including the domain-specific PLMs MentalBERT and MentalRoBERTa, except for BERT and RoBERTa.
We also use BART-Score and GPT3-Score to automatically evaluate explanations, which rely on LLMs to score fluency, reliability, and completeness.

We examine the quality of the generated explanations by two representative LLMs ... with human evaluations ... Each aspect is divided into four standards rating from 0 to 3.
We examine the quality of the generated explanations by two representative LLMs: ChatGPT and InstructGPT-3, with human evaluations on the binary mental health conditions detection task.
guideline: Specifically, four key aspects are assessed: 1) Fluency: the coherence and readability of the explanation. 2) Reliability: the trustworthiness of the generated explanations to support the prediction results. 3) Completeness: how well the generated explanations cover all relevant aspects of the original post. 4) Overall: the general effectiveness of the generated explanation.
Human annotators rate explanations on four aspects: Fluency, Reliability, Completeness, Overall, using a 0–3 scale.
